question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**arrived**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **turned: **move (something) so as to be aimed or pointed in a particular direction.
 
• **achieved: **successfully bring about or reach (a desired objective or result) by effort, skill, or courage.
 
• **arrived: **reach a place at the end of a journey or a stage in a journey.
 
• **reached: **stretch out an arm in a specified direction in order to touch or grasp something.
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**arrived**" is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
 
• **Example***: He arrived at the party just as we were about to cut the cake.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, we use the preposition **'at'**(after the blank) commonly with the verb **arrived**.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

**The complete passage is: **A banker taped a picture, drawn by one of his small children, to his office wall. When he ***1. arrived*** at work the next morning, he found the ***2. picture ***was covered by a ***3. large*** notice, saying he was in ***4. violation*** of company policy which required personal items to be put away at night. ***5. such*** a reaction was not just petty, it risked demotivating the banker completely. In short, it defied common sense.
